subject: How to tableOutput() a data frame with a character column?

messages.author: 559788c27381a3f3
messages.subject: How to tableOutput() a data frame with a character column?
parts:
I want to show a data frame in shiny app output window. When I use renderTable() (in the server code) and tableOutput() (in the ui code) I keep on getting this error: no applicable method for 'xtable' applied to an object of class "character". Indeed there is a character column, but I want to keep it in the data frame. Has onyone an idea about how to deal with this problem? Do I miss a simple solution?
Many thanks in advance!

messages.author: 559788c27381a3f3
messages.subject: Re: How to tableOutput() a data frame with a character column?
parts: I made it work! "solution": When I use uiOutput instead of tableOutput there is no problem with character values.
